sections.text: Let's Do This! Light of Saber!

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 360. Deal magic damage (Fire) 3 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases critical hit chance by 50% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 100 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Critical Assault (increases Ability Power when performing critical hits) buff limit by 50 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000
